name: Half Dome Trail
quote: The 14- to 16-mile round-trip hike to Half Dome ... (for a total of 4,800 feet) ... Most hikers take 10 to 12 hours to hike to Half Dome and back
why: The classic hike from Happy Isles to the summit of Half Dome via the Mist and John Muir Trails and the cables; a permit is required. km uses the low end of the range (16.4 mi = 26.4 km).

name: Top of Nevada Fall
quote: Top of Nevada Fall / Distance: 5.4 mi (8.7 km) round trip (via Mist Trail) / Elevation gain: 2000 ft (610 m) / Time: 5-6 hours
why: Part of the Vernal Fall and Nevada Fall Trails: the Mist Trail from Happy Isles past Vernal Fall to the top of 594 ft Nevada Fall.

name: Top of Vernal Fall
quote: Top of Vernal Fall / Distance: 2.4 mi (3.9 km) round trip (via Mist Trail) / Elevation gain: 1000 ft (300 m) / Time: 3 hours
why: Part of the Vernal Fall and Nevada Fall Trails: the Mist Trail's granite staircase of over 600 steps to the brink of Vernal Fall.

name: Vernal Fall Footbridge
quote: Vernal Fall Footbridge / Distance: 1.6 mi (2.6 km) round trip / Elevation gain: 400 ft (120 m) / Time: 1-1.5 hours
why: Part of the Vernal Fall and Nevada Fall Trails: the busy paved first section from Happy Isles to the footbridge with a view of Vernal Fall.

name: Top of Yosemite Falls
quote: Top of Yosemite Falls / Distance: 7.2 miles (11.6 km) round trip / Elevation: 2,700 ft (823 m) elevation gain / Time: 6-8 hours round trip
why: Part of the Yosemite Falls Trail: the historic switchback trail from Camp 4 to the top of 2,425 ft Yosemite Falls.

name: Columbia Rock
quote: Columbia Rock / Distance: 2 miles (3.2 km) round trip / Elevation: 1,000 ft (328 m) elevation gain / Time: 2-3 hours round trip
why: Part of the Yosemite Falls Trail: the first mile of switchbacks to the Columbia Rock viewpoint over Yosemite Valley.

name: Lower Yosemite Fall Trail
quote: Distance: 1 mile (1.6 km) loop / Elevation gain: Approximately 50 ft (15 m)
why: Easy loop, partly wheelchair accessible, to the base of Lower Yosemite Fall.

name: Mirror Lake Loop
quote: Distance: 2 miles (3.2 km) round trip to lake and back; 5 miles (8 km) loop around lake / Elevation: 100 feet / Time: 1 hour round trip to the lake (end of paved trail); 2-3 hours for full loop
why: Loop up Tenaya Creek past Mirror Lake below Half Dome. There is also a 2 mi / 3.2 km out-and-back to the lake.

name: Four Mile Trail
quote: Distance: 4.8 mi (7.7 km) one way to Glacier Point. 9.6 mi (15.5 km) round trip. / Elevation: 3,200 ft (975 m) elevation gain / Time: 3-4 hours one-way, 6-8 hours round trip
why: Steep historic toll trail from Southside Drive near Sentinel Rock up to Glacier Point.

name: Sentinel Dome
quote: Sentinel Dome / Time 1–2 hours / Distance 2 mi (3.2 km) round-trip / Elevation gain 400 ft (120 m)
why: Short walk off Glacier Point Road, then a scramble up the granite dome for 360-degree views.

name: Taft Point
quote: Taft Point / Time 1–2 hours / Distance 2.2 mi (3.5 km) round-trip / Elevation gain 200 ft (60 m) on return
why: Walk through forest and meadow to Taft Point on the Yosemite Valley rim, facing El Capitan.

name: Cathedral Lakes
quote: Cathedral Lakes / Time 6–7 hours / Distance 7.6 mi (12 km) round-trip / Elevation gain 1,000 ft (305 m) gain
why: Tuolumne's most popular trail, climbing to Upper Cathedral Lake, with a spur to Lower Cathedral Lake.

name: Panorama Trail
quote: Panorama Trail / Time 6–8 hours / Distance 8.2 mi (13.2 km) one way
why: One-way descent from Glacier Point via Illilouette Fall to Yosemite Valley, past Nevada and Vernal Falls; needs a car at the other end.

name: Valley Loop Trail
quote: Distance: 11.5 mi (18.5 km) full loop; 7.2 mi (11.6 km) half loop / Time: 5-7 hours full loop, 2.5-3.5 hours half loop
why: Mostly level loop around Yosemite Valley on historic trails and wagon roads. A half loop via El Capitan Bridge is also listed.

name: Snow Creek Trail
quote: Distance: 9.4 mi (15.1 km) round trip / Elevation gain: 2,700 ft (820 m) / Time: 6-7 hours
why: Grueling climb up switchbacks out of Tenaya Canyon, beyond Mirror Lake, to the valley rim.

name: Dewey Point
quote: Dewey Point / Time 4–5 hours / Distance 7.6 mi (13.2 km) round-trip / Elevation gain 750 ft (230 m)
why: From McGurk Meadow trailhead through meadow to Dewey Point on the valley rim, via the Pohono Trail.

name: Glen Aulin
quote: Glen Aulin / Time 6–8 hours / Distance 11 mi (17.7 km) round-trip / Elevation gain 800 ft (240 m) on return
why: Follows the Tuolumne River down from the Lembert Dome parking area to Glen Aulin.

name: Grizzly Giant Loop Trail
quote: Grizzly Giant Loop Trail / Time 1.5–2 hours / Distance 2 mi (3.2 km) round-trip / Elevation gain 300 ft (90 m)
why: Mariposa Grove sequoia walk past the Bachelor and Three Graces, the Grizzly Giant and the California Tunnel Tree.

name: Wapama Falls
quote: Wapama Falls / 5 mi (8 km) roundtrip / Elevation gain/loss: 507 ft (155 m)
why: Across O'Shaughnessy Dam and along the Hetch Hetchy Reservoir shore to Tueeulala and Wapama Falls.

name: Dog Lake & Lembert Dome
quote: Dog Lake & Lembert Dome / Time 3–4 hours / Distance 3.8 mi (6.1 km) round-trip / Elevation gain steep; 850 ft (260 m) gain
why: Out-and-back to Dog Lake with a side trip to the top of Lembert Dome; a 5-mile loop is also possible.

name: Gaylor Lakes
quote: Gaylor Lakes / Time 2–3 hours / Distance 2.6 mi (4.2 km) round-trip / Elevation gain Short but steep; 500 ft (152 m) gain
why: Steep climb from the Tioga Pass Entrance to a ridge, then down to Middle Gaylor Lake.

name: Elizabeth Lake
quote: Elizabeth Lake / Time 6–7 hours / Distance 6.8 mi (11 km) round-trip / Elevation gain 1,000 ft (305 m)
why: Steady climb from Tuolumne Meadows to a glacier-carved lake below Unicorn Peak.

name: North Dome
quote: North Dome / Time 5–7 hours / Distance 10.4 mi (16.7 km) round-trip / Elevation gain 580 ft (180 m) on return
why: From Porcupine Creek on Tioga Road through forest to the summit of North Dome, facing Half Dome.

name: Chilnualna Falls
quote: Chilnualna Falls / Time 5–7 hours / Distance 8.2 mi (13 km) round-trip / Elevation gain 2,400 ft (732 m)
why: Very challenging Wawona climb along cascading Chilnualna Creek to the falls.

name: Tuolumne Grove & Nature Trail
quote: Tuolumne Grove & Nature Trail / Time 1–2 hours / Distance 2.5 mi (4 km) round-trip / Elevation gain 500 ft (150 m) on return
why: Down a historic wagon road near Crane Flat to a small grove of giant sequoias and its nature trail.
